rules: REVERSAL: the answer reverses at 128-token replies if the shared_nr arm's mean completion time is lower than the hand-off's. Predicted 122.2 s against 153.2 s. (HANDOFF below is then predicted NOT to hold: the hand-off beats the repacked shared arm, 161.7 s, but not shared_nr.)

HANDOFF: the hand-off earns its place for two users arriving together if its mean completion time (the mean of the two users' done, averaged over the repetitions) is lower than BOTH shared arms' -- the Pi 5 alone as the sweep ran it (repacked) and at its best two-user configuration (--no-repack). Predicted 153.2 s against 161.7 and 122.2 s.
NOREPACK: the Pi 5's two-user decode step is cheaper without repacking, in llama-server as in llama-batched-bench, if shared_nr's measured mean TPOT is below shared's. Predicted 627 against 1061 ms.

ACCURACY: an arm's prediction holds if its measured mean completion time is within +-10 %% of the predicted one (the shared arm: of the nearer end of its range). Each user's TTFT, done and TPOT are reported against theirs either way.

STATIC-CHECK: both boards run 2-slot servers (a 1-slot server refuses a 2-slot server's saved state: 'n_stream mismatch', the smoke run of 21:47), so the static arm's two users should match the sweep's 1-slot pi5-alone and pi4-alone within 5 %% in both prefill and decode (the servers' own timings). A miss is reported and the other arms still scored.
STEADY: an arm is steady if its repetitions' mean completion times agree within 5 %; one that is not is reported as found and still scored.
